title: Privacy Mirror
subtitle: What the local chain evidence could reveal about your activity, with assumptions and missing data kept visible.

summaryBody.findings: These observations can make activity easier to connect. An inference is conditional on its stated assumptions; it is not proof of common ownership.
summaryBody.no_observed_exposure: This describes the evidence examined below. Missing history, hidden amounts and collaborative transactions limit what an outside observer can infer.
summaryBody.unavailable: The available observations cannot support a useful exposure assessment yet. Connect or import the relevant history, then refresh this local view.

groups.contextBody: Counterparty and nearby signals provide context. They do not establish your ownership or expose your own activity by themselves.

assistantPrompt: Read ui_reports_privacy_mirror for this book. Explain its most useful public-observer findings, separate my activity from surrounding context, state missing evidence and conditional assumptions, and suggest concrete next steps. Use local evidence only; ask before any network acquisition.

findingTitle.change_script_return: Possible change to a reused script
findingTitle.indirect_topological_contact: Indirect contact with a public attribution

findingDetail.script_reuse: The same locking script occurs on distinct locally observed outputs. Common control remains a hypothesis.
findingDetail.collaborative_boundary: Collaboration evidence suppresses common-input and change ownership assumptions; physical spends remain observable.
findingDetail.common_input_control: Observed inputs are spent together. Common control assumes an ordinary transaction without undetected collaboration.
findingDetail.change_script_return: One output returns to an input script. Change is a hypothesis; a payment to the same script remains an alternative.
findingDetail.unusual_transaction_version: The transaction uses an uncommon version; this does not identify a wallet.
findingDetail.ineffective_absolute_locktime: All input sequences are final, so the nonzero absolute locktime is disabled.
findingDetail.explicit_rbf_signal: At least one input explicitly signals BIP125 replacement; relay and replacement depend on node policy.
findingDetail.op_return_output: An observed output carries an OP_RETURN script; its payload is not included in this analysis.
findingDetail.rounded_fee_rate: The observed fee rate is close to a common integer rate; many wallets and manual settings share it.
findingDetail.relative_lock_constraints: Input sequences encode relative lock constraints; maturity needs prevout confirmation context.
findingDetail.mixed_input_script_types: The input scripts use multiple templates. This is a structural distinction, not an ownership link.
findingDetail.mixed_output_script_types: The output scripts use multiple templates. This is a structural distinction, not an ownership link.
findingDetail.equal_output_groups: Repeated output amounts provide a CoinJoin hypothesis, but also occur in ordinary batches.
findingDetail.consolidation_shape: Several inputs create one output, consistent with consolidation or a jointly funded payment.
findingDetail.batch_payment_shape: Many outputs are consistent with a payment batch; output roles remain unknown.
findingDetail.consistent_low_r_encoding: All observed ECDSA signatures use low-R encodings. Several wallets share this behavior and chance can produce it.
findingDetail.nondefault_sighash: An observed signature uses a sighash other than DEFAULT or ALL; its commitment scope differs.
findingDetail.fan_in: Inputs from multiple observed parent transactions are spent together. This is topology, not common ownership.
findingDetail.fan_out: Different outputs have locally observed spends in different later transactions.
findingDetail.reconvergence: Distinct output branches reach the same later transaction through observed spends. No unique value allocation or common owner is inferred.
findingDetail.postmix_reconvergence: Distinct output branches from a CoinJoin boundary reach the same later transaction. The interpretation depends on that boundary; no unique value allocation or common owner is inferred.
findingDetail.peel_chain_candidate: At least three unmarked 1-input/2-output transactions continue through the larger output. Repeated payments and ownership remain hypotheses; undetected collaboration can invalidate them.
findingDetail.direct_label_match: A locally imported public dataset names this subject. The claim is not verified ownership.
findingDetail.indirect_topological_contact: Observed transaction links reach a subject named by a locally imported public dataset. This is not evidence of payment, ownership or taint.
